title: Ijwi ry’ibinyejana n’ibindi ritarumviwe
intro: Mu gihe kirekire imbere y’uko ibisagara bininibinini bihaguruka, umutima w’irungu warahagurutse mu bantu bari barahevye ukuri. Ubutagondwa bwabo bwahuye gusa n’ukwihangana kw’uwo muhamagara wenyene, yariko arasenga mu mayaruka ataco atakaje. Igihe imburi zose zagwa mu matwi y’ibipfamatwi, igiharuro kitari bwigere kibaho carahinduye isi ubwayo. Muri iki gihe, ijwi ry’iyo nkuru riracariho mu gusoma kwose. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo mutima wiyemeje?
clues: Nakuriye mu bantu basenga ibigirwamana vy’ibinyoma kandi bakirengagiza ibimenyetso vyari bibakikuje, yamara naratowe kugira ngo mbavyure mu bujuju bwabo.
Narahamagara abantu banje incuro nyinshi, ariko barandega ko ata kindi ndi atari umuntu nka bo, bagatwenga ubutumwa bwanje, bagapfuka amatwi yabo.
Ijoro n’umurango, narabinginga n’ubwenge n’ivyibutsa vy’ubugwaneza, ariko amajambo yanje yasa n’ayazimangana mu kirere, ata wumva kandi ata wumvirizwa.
Narigishijwe n’Imana, nubatse igikoresho kinini c’ibiti n’ibiti ku butaka bwumye, maze abantu banje barantwengera mw’ijigo nk’umuntu yatakaje ubwenge.
Igihe umwuzure munini waza nk’uko vyari vyasezeranywe, umuhungu wanje bwite yaranse kwinjirana nanje mu bwato, yizera ko umusozi womukingira amazi yariko araduga.
Nacitse umuvyeyi w’intango nshasha kw’isi, kandi inkuru yanje irazigamye mu kigabane ca Korowani citwa izina ryanje nyene.
